name: Landmine Rotation
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine holder, stand facing it, and hold the free end with both hands at chest height, arms extended.
Keeping your arms straight, rotate the bar in an arc to one side, pivoting your feet and turning your torso.
Rotate back through the center and over to the other side.
Brace your core and move from your trunk, not your arms. Use a light load.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with both hands holding the end of a landmine bar at chest height, arms extended.
